config:
model = "fixture-v2"

multi_agent = true

plugins = false
apps = false

name = "Fixture"
base_url = "http://127.0.0.1:46337/v1"

stream_max_retries = 0

[projects."$ROOT/repository"]
trust_level = "trusted"
